I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I'd noted that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats. As she asked, I didn't change anything.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in that channel, so repeating it there was fine. I also suggested she correct her earlier post in #north-team so the team sees the right number. I wrote that the old post "still shows the old number," but I didn't open #north-team to check. That rests only on what she told me.

I don't keep records between conversations, so this correction is only stored in that Slack thread.
